title: Flood, South Sudan, 23 October 2019 (FL20191023SSD)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, South Sudan, 23 October 2019 (FL20191023SSD), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20191023SSD**  This map illustrates satellite-detected surface water in Unity, Jonglei and Lakes State of South Sudan as observed from Sentinel-1 imagery acquired on 23 October 2019. Within the analysed extent of about 85,000  km2, a total about 1,180 km2 of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
 Important Note: Flood analysis from Sentinel-1 imagery acquired on 23 October 2019 may seriously underestimate the presence of standing floodwater in built-up areas due to backscattering of the radar signal

HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected waters extents, as of 23 October 2019 over Unity, Jonglei and Lakes State of South Sudan](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-extents-as-of-23-october-2019-over-unity-jonglei-and-lakes-state-of-south-sudan)
- [Satellite-detected cumulative water extents, as of 06  November 2019 over Luakpiny/Nasir, Pibor](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cumulative-water-extents-as-of-06-november-2019-over-luakpiny-nasir-pibor)
